notes: All figures come from LVMH's 2025 Universal Registration Document (fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025), filed with the AMF. LVMH reports three single countries (France, United States, Japan), which are in countries, and three remainder regions (Europe excl. France, Asia excl. Japan, Other markets), whose country lists the filing does not define. Each table is its own row, so France, the U.S. and Japan appear three times (stores, employees, operating investments) with different metric keys. The investment table calls the last region 'Other countries', not 'Other markets', and the name is kept as filed. The workforce total (211,552 at Dec 31, 2025, including temporary and non-guaranteed-hours contracts) is a different measure from headcounts reported elsewhere; the URD notes a rationalization of the non-guaranteed-hours workforce in the United States in 2025. Store counts include Sephora (2,242 stores). The URD has no U.S. state breakdown and no taxes-by-country table (a search of the 2025 URD for 'country-by-country', 'tax contribution' and 'taxes paid' found nothing); a separate LVMH tax report was not checked. Vineyard areas are in hectares and appear only in site descriptions. Some site quotes are shortened to text that is contiguous in the PDF's two-column layout.
